claims.claim: statewright | 349 | +35 in 6d + HN 124pts | Rust | FSL-1.1 | agent infra
claims.source_evidence: Star count of 349 and Rust language are correct. However two values are wrong: (1) The HN post (https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48108778) shows 126 points, not 124. (2) The license is not plain FSL-1.1: the repo uses Apache 2.0 as the base with FSL-1.1-ALv2 applying to the MCP gateway component only (converts to Apache 2.0 in 2029). The Quick Stats cell simplifies this to 'FSL-1.1' which is inaccurate — HN itself shows a comment thread questioning the license because Cargo.toml says Apache 2.
claims.suggested_fix: statewright | 349 | +35 in 6d + HN 126pts | Rust | Apache-2.0 / FSL-1.1-ALv2 | agent infra
